title: Pilot services correlation pack
notes: This pack covers the Gitea, PostgreSQL, Valkey, and Navidrome service tier.
It is intentionally tuned around runtime instability and access-error bursts rather than every single application log line.
The pack relies on the pilot service units and forwarded application logs being present on the fleet nodes.

stream_rules.title: Pilot Service Runtime Instability
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the affected service unit and recent rollout history. Validate whether the node is recovering automatically or needs intervention.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Pilot Service Runtime Instability
id: sigma-pilot-service-runtime-instability
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: infrastructure
  service: host_metrics
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: host.metrics
    event.type: host_service_flapping
    host.name:
      - pilot-web-01
      - pilot-db-01
      - pilot-cache-01
      - navidrome-01
  condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
  - pilot
  - services
  - flapping

stream_rules.title: Pilot Service Telemetry Missing
stream_rules.operator_action: Check host-runtime delivery, rsyslog forwarding, and whether the service node is reachable and intentionally online.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Pilot Service Telemetry Missing
id: sigma-pilot-service-telemetry-missing
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: infrastructure
  service: host_metrics
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: host.metrics
    event.type: host_telemetry_stale
    host.name:
      - pilot-web-01
      - pilot-db-01
      - pilot-cache-01
      - navidrome-01
  condition: selection
level: high
tags:
  - pilot
  - telemetry
  - stale

stream_rules.title: Pilot Service Auth Error Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the application access logs and verify whether the errors come from legitimate user retries or brute-force style access attempts.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Pilot Service Auth Error Burst
id: sigma-pilot-service-auth-error-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: app_logs
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name:
      - pilot-web-01
      - navidrome-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - login failed
      - authentication failed
      - invalid password
      - bad credentials
  condition: selection_host and selection_message
level: medium
tags:
  - pilot
  - auth
  - access

batch_rules.title: Pilot Service Error Trend Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review for repetitive access and error spikes across the pilot application tier.
